posts.title: Blogging on the Bus
posts.description: In the last year I have gained a new routine. Every Monday, after I come home from work and wash up and all that, I go out again and I get on the bus to go visit my partner. I do have a car, but parking at my destination is nonexistent. It usually takes about an hour or so. Usually I read while I ride the bus. Well, usually I scroll on my phone most of the time. posts.title: November Writing Month
posts.description: November has somehow come already. Where is it that time goes? And why is it in such a hurry? Once upon a time there was something called Nanowrimo, in which people challenged themselves to write a 50,000 word novel in the month of November.
